description: Open a perpetual futures position on HyperLiquid (market or limit) with leverage and optional TP/SL. Always pass leverage: it is set with the order and, when omitted, the back-end applies the market's MAXIMUM. Margin mode is chosen by the back-end (builder-DEX `dex:ASSET` and isolated-only markets are isolated, the rest cross). A limit (isMarket=false) at or through the mark price is refused unless reduceOnly; reduceOnly + isMarket=false rests as a limit close. TP and SL attach only as a pair; edit them later with modify_perp_order, add a missing one with add_position_tpsl. Min order value $11.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

apiKey.description: GDEX API key for AES encryption

isLong.description: True for long, false for short

isMarket.description: True for market order, false for limit

leverage.description: Leverage, 1 up to the market's own maximum (higher is clamped). Set with this order; omitted = the market's MAXIMUM. For a reduce-only order pass the position's current leverage.

price.description: Market: mark-price reference ('0' fetches the mark). Limit: the resting price in USD

reduceOnly.description: Reduce-only order (with isMarket=false: a resting limit close)

slPrice.description: Stop-loss price in USD, '' to skip

tpPrice.description: Take-profit price in USD, '' to skip

name: open_perp_position
